paragraphs: Palm Charcoal is a Saudi brand specialized in producing, importing, and supplying premium natural charcoal — delivering consistent quality and superior performance to the Saudi market, the Gulf, and customers worldwide. Our solutions serve individuals, cafés, restaurants, hotels, distributors, and export companies.

We are headquartered in Jeddah's historic Al-Balad district, in the Charcoal Souq — one of the oldest and most renowned charcoal markets in the Kingdom — where we have built deep practical expertise and a precise understanding of customer needs across markets.

We carefully select the finest natural charcoal and raw materials, applying strict quality control across production, packaging, and storage to deliver long burn time, stable heat, low ash, and a clean, odor-free profile — ideal for hookah, incense, BBQ, and industrial use.

Beyond products, we build long-term strategic partnerships through wholesale, project supply, and regional and international export — committed to on-time delivery, consistent quality, and professional service.
We proudly represent Saudi quality in the charcoal industry, continuously developing our products and operations to meet the highest standards.
Our vision: to become one of the leading charcoal brands across the Middle East and global markets through innovation, quality, sustainability, and trust.
